saw_lines: Bed linen is chosen by feel and colour, and most buyers compare a few sets before choosing one.
So the sale is won or lost in the opening line and photo, before a buyer picks which set to compare.
Your 18 of 26 ads open on one line, so buyers see one pitch. Write three new openers from your striped navy duvet cover and towels and test them against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: 18 of 26 copy ads open on the same line, “découvrez notre sélection de linge”, so buyers see one pitch repeated. Write three new openers from your striped navy duvet cover and bath towels, then test them against this line.
One exact copy runs in 14 of 26 ads, so buyers see the same words twice. Keep the body text, but change the opening line and creative in each, with a different product shot or room for every one.
No proof number in your ads

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing to trust before clicking. Collect one figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and put it on the creative of every new ad.
Shop now ads skip the product
4 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the product shown, so the click has to start over. Point each of those 4 ads to its product page and match the image to the item on that page.

ads_1: Striped navy duvet and towel creative, three new openers tested against the current line
